sloka: सुपत्रवाजिता बाणा ज्वलिता इव पन्नगाः।नैर्ऋतोरस्यभासन्त सवितू रश्मयो यथा ।। ६.८८.३१ ।।
transliteration: supatravājitā bāṇā jvalitā iva pannagāḥ।nairṛtorasyabhāsanta savitū raśmayo yathā ।। 6.88.31 ।।

translations.english: The arrows being tied to good feathers glowing like serpents shone on the chest of Rakshasa like the rays of Sun.
